title: GoalPacket/1.0
description: A machine-evaluable goal for one ant-world round. Emitted as a FILE (not prose) so a distinct trial can schema-compare instead of prose-compare (plan ant-world-goal-round-1, amendment r2 disposition, codex F9). Every threshold carries its own derivation object, so no number in a packet can be asserted without the observed datum it came from. The evaluator (tools/ant-hive-world/goal-evaluator.js) is read-only and reads only allowlisted ecology fields of the sanitized world-state; spatial and build surfaces are unreachable through it by construction.

goal_id.description: Stable identity. Travels into every evaluator trace row and into the checkpoint manifest's goal field, so a goal-bearing lineage can never silently become goal:null.

created_for.description: The plan/task id this packet was derived for.

evaluator_version.description: Must equal the runtime EVALUATOR_VERSION exported by goal-evaluator.js. A mismatch is a validation failure, not a warning: an evaluation is only meaningful against the evaluator that defined its aggregations.

deadline.description: The explicit bound the convene synthesis requires. absolute_tick MUST equal turns * ticks_per_turn.

safety_bounds.description: Bounds asserted by the packet AND enforced by the evaluator's allowlist. The first three flags have fixed required values; a packet asserting otherwise fails validation.

intervenes_on_extinction.description: The deterministic extinction rule: if a hive reaches zero the round runs to its deadline unmodified and the outcome is recorded. Extinction is data, not a fault to be prevented by evaluator design.

reference_artifacts.description: Repo-relative paths of the artifacts every derivation_datum was read from.

horizon_matching_rule.description: Why these observations and not others. Observations at a different horizon than the round's deadline are corroboration, never the primary datum.

packet_sha256.description: sha256 over the canonical (key-sorted, whitespace-free) JSON of this packet with packet_sha256 removed. Same rule as the checkpoint manifest's manifest_self_checksum. A mismatch is the tamper gate: the driver refuses before constructing any state.

threshold.description: THE NUMERIC DERIVATION CONTRACT (codex F2). Every threshold ships the number, its units, the formula that produced it, the exact world-state path it is compared against, the aggregation scope, and the observed datum it derives from. A threshold missing any of these is a validation failure, which is what makes 'derived, not invented' checkable rather than claimed.

formula.description: The arithmetic that produced `value` from `derivation_datum`, written so a reviewer can recompute it.

source_field.description: Exact path in the sanitized world-state. MUST be one of the evaluator's allowlisted ecology fields; territory, geometry_log, food_source_coords and pheromones are rejected.

aggregation_scope.description: Per-hive vs combined, and which ticks the comparison applies to (e.g. 'combined world total, evaluated every tick, verdict at the deadline tick').

artifact.description: Repo-relative path of the record the number was read from.

corroboration.description: Observations at a different horizon that bound the threshold from outside. Never the primary datum.
